# Original SolidWorks geometry and document thumbnails

The native documents are copied byte-for-byte from [GuoXiong's Power-Package](https://github.com/guoxxiong/Power-Package) at commit `bc6b8d0ca0fe472a4f0ed91c9e64f986b3ddc7e6`. They are separately MIT licensed; the complete original notice is retained in `POWER-PACKAGE-LICENSE.txt`. Filename case is normalized locally without changing file contents.

| Local file | Original path | Source SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `solidworks-about.sldprt` | [`about.SLDPRT`](https://github.com/guoxxiong/Power-Package/blob/bc6b8d0ca0fe472a4f0ed91c9e64f986b3ddc7e6/about.SLDPRT) | `08a8ec2afc112a27b1b8f4fad92224080b5c0d8cda8fc095b423cf91ca062e34` |
| `solidworks-powerpackage.sldasm` | [`powerpackage.SLDASM`](https://github.com/guoxxiong/Power-Package/blob/bc6b8d0ca0fe472a4f0ed91c9e64f986b3ddc7e6/powerpackage.SLDASM) | `2e71fb43b889a5d9585eb7606266a1dd35ef685244df6ee65782a7f7b2f19788` |

Both files use CFB v3 with 512-byte sectors. Their exact root `PreviewPNG` streams are 640×480 RGBA PNG images. The `.preview.png` references are the original stream bytes extracted independently with Python `olefile`, without using Catwalk's extractor. The `.preview-dib.png` references are the original root `Preview` DIBs independently decoded with Pillow 10.2: strip the four-byte length, add a BMP file header with its palette-adjusted pixel offset, decode and save RGBA. The original DIBs are 1418×696 RLE8 images. `provenance.json` records document, PNG stream, DIB stream and decoded DIB pixel hashes.

The part is a 290 × 200 × 230 mm block: the native Keywords XML gives sketch dimensions 290 and 230, and extrusion depth 200. Its twelve source 3D display triangles independently reproduce the resulting 341,400 mm² surface area and 13,340,000 mm³ volume. Geometry tests also remove the display cache and exercise the solved Parasolid boundary conversion.

The original assembly addresses seven distinct part documents through nine placed occurrences, including two repeated prototypes and rotations. Those seven companions are retained beside the assembly with their original names and contents. `geometry-provenance.json` records exact source hashes and sizes. The assembly's own component-instance XML gives independent model/file/configuration joins, metre-valued transformation matrices and its complete bounding box. The resulting 13,074 source mesh triangles match that placed bounding box to 0.0001 mm, including the native float cache's rounding and the producer bounding-box tolerance.

Geometry decoding uses complete native three-dimensional positions, shading normals and triangle indices, independently of either raster preview. A display cache is admitted only for one resolved, saved active part/configuration with no required rebuild, complete native face/table counts and complete vertex/triangle inventories. Optional face-to-table identity joins do not change whole-part ownership when the part has only one body and configuration. Invalid or incomplete native geometry fails explicitly. Typed native diffuse appearances are retained when the decoder provides them; these particular source meshes do not carry transferred colors.

The cache-free B-rep projection restores each original native bridge's `+`/`-` carrier-relative face sense at the decoder's exact retained-source offset. This corrects the pinned codec's shell-parity overwrite, which otherwise loses the normal direction on some faces. Negative native torus major radii retain the decoder's chart-orientation adjustment through the separately addressed source surface. The restoration admits bounded complete kernel frames and rejects ambiguous partition/deltas ownership; it changes no source geometry, model placement or document bytes.

`tests/solidworks_geometry.rs` checks physical dimensions, surface area, oriented volume, normals, immutable source hashes, all nine assembly placements and geometry survival after deleting every addressed saved image from the assembly and all companions. Controls cover missing companions, stale states, malformed XML and joins, non-rigid placements, hidden components, cycles and symlink escapes. The original producer files remain unchanged; only temporary copies are mutated for controls.

`tests/solidworks_saved_previews.rs` fixes source hashes, compares public extraction to the independent PNGs, and exercises the original RLE8 fallback by deleting only `PreviewPNG` in temporary copies. Unit tests author CFB v3/v4 carriers for selection, absent/corrupt images, original mini-FAT cycles and allocation limits. Authoring a carrier or renaming a source does not qualify a SolidWorks application version.

Native part decoding also recognizes the upstream decoder's supported modern section envelope. Assembly geometry currently qualifies the SolidWorks 7000 component-instance XML inside a compound document, with supplied local companions and rigid placements. Virtual/flexible components, unresolved or stale configurations, assembly features that change component result geometry, unsupported local assembly bodies and unsupported carriers fail explicitly. Saved-preview extraction of modern section containers remains a separate unsupported path.
